name: github-auth
description: Mints short-lived GitHub App installation tokens on the host, from a private key that never enters the container, and authenticates gh/git inside the container with them.

settings.label: GitHub App ID
settings.description: Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → your app.

settings.label: Private key file
settings.description: Host path to the App's .pem private key. It never enters the container: the host mints short-lived tokens from it.

settings.label: GitHub host
settings.description: Your Enterprise Server hostname, to target GHES.

settings.label: Username
settings.description: Account git and gh authenticate as; the web UI also lists pull requests as this account of the host's gh login. Default: the App's bot login.
